_notes: Transcribed from scans: Obol AM0353-0359, Moiros AO0378-0385, Kratos AN0372-0377, Trauma AM0307-0352 (+ Cycle II BM / Cycle III CM cards), Conditions AL0299-0306.

Trauma cards carry: polarity (+ positive / - negative; Hekaton IX 'Ruthless' removes positives), and on Minor cards an arrow (up/left/right/down/spiral) and on Major cards a number 1-8 - both are random-direction / random-number lookup aids (rulebook: random direction / random number draws), not effects.
Mnestis rule (p.70): you are in the Cycle of the Primordial you fight, so for Cycle I Primordials build decks with cycle = null or 1 only.
Codes AM0349 and AM0355 were not in the scans - deck may have one more Grave Trauma and one more Obol card (TBC).
Icons: RAGE=Ω, FATE=Ψ, DANGER=Λ, PT = Priority Target token. Unresolved icons marked [TBC:...].
AM0349 = Awakening (Trauma secret card 6), AM0355 = You Died/Awaken (Obol secret card 7): only added once Awakening is unlocked.
godforms: bottom-row stats read from scans; Godform Power die colour (black) and Demeter's '+1 die' (read as +1 black Armor die) are TBC.
2026-10-20: Cycle IV Godforms (Secret cards 246-248) Dionysus, Aphrodite, Helios Apollon Exalted added (only Helios is Exalted). The '▼' cost on these cards = Trespass token.

2026-10-20: Exalted Godforms (exalted:true) = Tier II Awakening. Gradual: Awaken while already awakened → choose an Exalted Godform, refresh Trespass. Grand Theft: choose an Exalted Godform during a normal Awakening → Fused Souls, death cannot be avoided, only 1 Trespass. All Exalted: Bonus Action + Cryptex Loathing.

Fear.text: You have -2 Precision. If you gain this Condition card a second time or you gain the Dread Condition card, flip this card (to Dread).
Fear.faceYourFear: When you deal a Wound, discard this Condition card and gain 1 positive Precision token.
Fear.endOfBattle: If you still have this Condition card, draw a Fated Mnemos card.

Dread.text: You have -4 Precision. While on a Rear space, Weakspot or VP, you have -2 Precision instead. If you gain this Condition card a second time or you gain the Fear Condition card, you die.
Dread.faceYourFear: When you deal a Wound, discard this Condition card and gain 2 positive Precision tokens.
Dread.endOfBattle: If you still have this Condition card, draw a Fated Mnemos card.

Knockdown (falling down).text: You are knocked down. You cannot move voluntarily, attack or use actions or abilities, unless stated otherwise. If this card is discarded by another effect, stand up. At the end of your next turn, flip this card (to standing up).

Knockdown (standing up).text: If you move voluntarily, attack or use an action or ability, stand up. At the start of your turn, stand up. If this card is discarded by another effect, stand up. Stand up: put your miniature in the normal position and discard this card.

Bellerophonic.text: Add +2 to Climb and Hold on tests. If you gain this card again, automatically move to the VP (even if not adjacent!) or, if you are already on the VP, you may gain +1 FATE to perform a Bonus Attack!

Bleeding.text: Start of your turn: Gain 1 Bleeding token, then draw as many cards from your Trauma level deck as you have Bleeding tokens. Remove all revealed positive cards from the battle and return all the negative ones to the top of the deck in the same order.
Bleeding.bleedingLimit: Bleeding Limit 4: If there are 0 Bleeding tokens on this card, discard it. If Bleeding tokens on this card exceed your Bleeding Limit (default 4), you die.
Bleeding.stopBleeding: Stop Bleeding: [Move action] or [Attack action] to discard up to 2 Bleeding tokens from yourself.
Bleeding.stopBleedingOther: Stop Bleeding Other: As a free action, discard up to 2 Bleeding tokens from an adjacent Titan.

Death.text: Your death has been prophesized. Start of your turn: Discard 1 Death token from this card. If you can't discard a token, you die.

Paralyzed.text: You are paralyzed. You cannot move voluntarily, attack or use actions or abilities, unless stated otherwise. When you are attacked, do not perform the Evasion Roll. Instead you are automatically hit and you do not perform the Armor Roll.
Paralyzed.snapOut: Start of your turn: You may test Endurance (DANGER+). Success: Discard this card.

Roused.text: For the purpose of Kratos Table abilities treat your RAGE as 1 higher.

Sisyphean.text: Level 1. You have -1 Speed. Your cards cannot unexhaust. Ignore Tireless. When the Burden attacks a Titan with Sisyphean, apply the following additional effects: Attack gains +1 Attack Die, each hit deals +1 DANGER. When another Titan gains Sisyphean, and there are no more Sisyphean cards in the game, pass this Condition card to that Titan.

Time-clocked.text: DEPARTING: You have been punched into the future. Remove your miniature from the Board. You cannot move voluntarily, attack or use actions or abilities or suffer Rewind or be Targeted unless stated otherwise. If this card is discarded by another effect, arrive. At the end of your next turn, flip this card.
Time-clocked.arriving: ARRIVING: If you move voluntarily, attack or use an action or ability, arrive. At the start of your turn, arrive. If this card is discarded by another effect, arrive.
Time-clocked.arrive: Place your miniature on your Time Anchor and discard this card. If your Time Anchor is not on the Board at the moment of arrival, you are erased from existence instead.

Muffled.text: You cannot voluntarily gain FATE. If you gain this Condition a second time or you gain the Sealed Condition card, flip this card (to Sealed). Start of your turn: You may draw and resolve a Major Trauma. If you do, discard this Condition card and lose -1 FATE.
Muffled.endOfBattle: If you still have this Condition card, draw a Fated Mnemos card.

Sealed.text: You cannot voluntarily gain FATE. You cannot gain RAGE. If you gain this Condition card a second time or you gain the Muffled Condition card, you die. Start of your turn: You may draw and resolve a Grave Trauma. If you do, discard this Condition card and lose -2 FATE.
Sealed.endOfBattle: If you still have this Condition card, draw a Fated Mnemos card.

Omega Terminus.text: While on this card, during your turn, you can only unexhaust and/or attack. If you deal a Wound, place your Titan on a space adjacent to the Timefront in a straight line from the Oracle. If you fail to Wound, ignore Responses. At the end of your turn, if you're still in the Omega Terminus, you are erased from existence. Zeus Godform gains +1 Power here.

Hatred.text: You cannot break Combos or use abilities that place tokens in the Kratos Pool. If you gain this Condition card a second time or you gain the Frenzy Condition card, flip this card (to Frenzy).
Hatred.calmDown: End of your turn: If you did not attack this turn, discard this card and gain 1 positive Precision token.
Hatred.endOfBattle: If you still have this Condition card, gain a Fated Mnemos card.

Frenzy.text: You cannot break Combos, use Kratos tokens from the Kratos Pool or use abilities that place tokens in the Kratos Pool. If you gain this Condition card a second time or you gain the Hatred Condition card, you die.
Frenzy.calmDown: End of your turn: If you did not attack this turn, discard this card and gain 2 positive Precision tokens.
Frenzy.endOfBattle: If you still have this Condition card, gain a Fated Mnemos card.

Float.text: FLOAT (UP): You are floating. Place your Titan on its side as a reminder. You cannot move voluntarily, attack or use actions or abilities, unless stated otherwise. If you gain this Condition card a second time, you die. If this card is discarded by another effect, deflate (see the other side of the card). At the end of your next turn, flip this card.
Float.back: FLOAT (DOWN): If you move voluntarily, attack or use an action or ability, deflate. At the start of your turn, deflate. If this card is discarded by another effect, deflate. DEFLATE: Put your miniature in the normal position and discard this card.

Covetous.text: When you place tokens in the Kratos Pool, you may only place half (rounding down). If you gain this Condition card a second time or you gain the Greed-crazed Condition card, flip this card.
Covetous.Giveaway: When you remove (discard, turn) 2+ Midas tokens as a result of any single effect, discard this Condition card and gain the Enriched Condition card and 1 positive Precision token.
Covetous.End of Battle: If you still have this Condition card, draw a Fated Mnemos card.

Greed-crazed.text: When you place tokens in the Kratos Pool, you may only place half (rounding down). You may only use half (rounding down) of the tokens in the Kratos Pool. If you gain this Condition card a second time or you gain the Covetous Condition card, you die.
Greed-crazed.Giveaway: When you remove (discard, turn) 4+ Midas tokens as a result of any single effect, discard this Condition card and gain the Enlightened Condition card and 2 positive Precision tokens.
Greed-crazed.End of Battle: If you still have this Condition card, draw a Fated Mnemos card.

Enriched.text: You cannot involuntarily gain tokens or Condition cards (excluding Ambrosia and Trespass). Discard this card at the end of the next Primordial Round.

Enlightened.text: You may discard any tokens and Condition cards (excluding Ambrosia). You cannot involuntarily gain tokens or Condition cards (excluding Ambrosia and Trespass). Discard this card at the end of the next Primordial Round.

Wishkeen.text: You ignore Wish Armor. +1 to all Wish Aways you suffer. If you gain this Condition card a second time or you gain the Wishagog Condition card, flip this card.
Wishkeen.What You Wish For: During your turn, you may choose for the Primordial to immediately perform a Signature against you. You cannot gain the Wishkeen Condition card from this Signature. If you survive the Attack, discard this Condition card and gain the Enriched Condition card and 1 positive Precision token.
Wishkeen.End of Battle: If you still have this Condition card, draw a Fated Mnemos card.

Wishagog.text: You ignore Wish Armor. +2 to all Wish Aways you suffer. If you gain this Condition card a second time or you gain the Wishkeen Condition card, you die.
Wishagog.What You Wish For: During your turn, you may choose for the Primordial to immediately perform an AI card against you. You cannot gain Wishkeen or Wishagog Condition cards from this Attack. If you survive the Attack, discard this Condition card and gain the Enlightened Condition card and 3 positive Precision tokens.
Wishagog.End of Battle: If you still have this Condition card, draw a Fated Mnemos card.

Resolve.text: You have +2 Precision and Auto-break 1. Discard this card if you fully miss an Attack or Fail to wound.

Bravery.text: When you gain this card, discard any Fear, Dread, Terror, or Holy Terror Condition cards. If you would gain a Terror or Holy Terror Condition card, ignore that gain and discard this card instead.

Lander.text: When on a VP, you cannot suffer a Falling Down effect, Knockdown, Knockback, Pushback, Kickback, Wish Away or Float. When on a VP, you cannot be moved to the Endless Staircase. Start of your turn: Discard this card.

Goldthirst.text: At the start of each of your turns, gain 1 Midas token.

Windblight.text: Gain +1 Movement and raise all Knockbacks, Pushbacks, Kickbacks and Airbursts you suffer by 2. When you are about to suffer Knockdown, suffer Float instead.

Terror.text: Awakening Lock. You don't benefit from Precision Bonuses (except for Kratos tokens). During an Attack Roll, if you roll at least one '1', your Attack immediately ends with a full miss. If you gain this Condition card a second time or gain the Holy Terror Condition card, flip this card.
Terror.Calm as the Sea: When you deal a Wound, discard this Condition card and gain the Bravery Condition card.
Terror.End of Battle: If you still have this Condition card, do not discard it during the Battle Aftermath.

Holy Terror.text: Awakening Lock. You don't benefit from Precision Bonuses (except for Kratos tokens). During an Attack Roll, if you roll at least one '1', your Attack immediately ends with a full miss. After you perform the Attack Roll, if you didn't get a Crit Chance, discard 1 hit. If you gain this Condition card a second time or gain the Terror Condition card, you die.
Holy Terror.Calm as the Sea: When you deal a Wound, discard this Condition card and gain the Bravery Condition card.
Holy Terror.End of Battle: If you still have this Condition card, do not discard it during the Battle Aftermath.

Abyss.text: At the start of each of your turns, gain 1 Ambrosia token.

Pursuer.text: At the end of each of your turns, you must turn 1 Midas token into an Ambrosia token. If you cannot do this, you die.

abilities.Fly: Ψ⟳ Use during voluntary movement to ignore all Terrain tiles during this movement. You cannot end your movement on an Obstacle or Chasm. Ψ⟳ When you are about to perform a Climb test, automatically succeed at that test instead.
abilities.Pitiful as the Sun: You cannot die from any Curse.
abilities.Trigger Finger: [Combat action] Lose 1 Trespass token to perform an Attack with your Finger! ◆3 +0, Power: white die. Range 3-10, Fire X, where X is your Total Power during this Attack.

special.name: Finger (Helios Apollon)
special.text: Ranged 3-10. Fire X, where X is your Total Power during this Attack.

abilities.All Things End: When you deal a Wound, you may lose -1 Trespass to place 1 negative AT token in the Kratos Pool.
abilities.Inverted Death: When you would gain any Danger, you lose the same amount of Danger instead (if it was dealt, you still resolve a Trauma Draw). Once you reach 0 Danger, you begin to gain Danger as normal (including the remaining Danger from the effect that lowered your Danger value to 0). When it happens, place a generic token on this ability as a reminder.
